title: No Tickets? Here’s How to Watch Phish Live at Sphere in Las Vegas Online
summary: The band will be performing at the Las Vegas Sphere across three weekends starting April 16.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Phish announced that they’d be taking over the Las Vegas Sphere for a stint, following their 2024 performance at the venue.

This time around, the band has a nine-show residency starting on Thursday, April 16, spanning three weekends. Dates include April 16–18, April 23–25 and April 30–May 2. Prior to this, Phish performed a sold-out four-night residency at Sphere from April 18–21 in 2024. The group was the second act to ever play the venue, following U2. The “Fling Your Head” band is part of a slew of impressive acts that have performed at the unique venue, including Dead & Company, Eagles, Backstreet Boys , Anyma, ILLENIUM, No Doubt , Kenny Chesney and Metallica .

For those unfamiliar, Sphere opened in late 2023. It is a 366-foot-tall and 516-foot-wide spherical entertainment venue with a 580,000-square-foot exterior LED display meant to give attendees an immersive experience from their seats with 360-degree views.
